narrator_note: Narrator line = 'Voice-over: ' + preset, word for word the same in every clip (no 'the same ...' follow-up wording: the video model cannot see other clips). Presets are studio voice profiles; leave out breaths, pauses, hesitations and words-per-minute numbers, which make the voice drift. Presets other than the original documentary voice (narrator_en) are untested; test with 4 s clips (7 credits) only with owner approval.
